summary: Sinovac Biotech Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing its unaudited and unreviewed financial results for the second half of 2025 and audited results for the full year ended December 31, 2025, along with the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F. No strategic transaction, activist campaign, or corporate event is disclosed. The release details sales declines and net losses, CEO commentary on overseas growth and vaccine approvals, but contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or special-situation structure. The filing is a routine periodic financial report for a foreign private issuer.
